[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-ii[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob gmail sync — label-routed Gmail threads watched for replies [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]until their task closes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Labelling a Gmail thread `bob` (plus an optional `#/<note>` or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`+/<note>` routing label) files one task into that area or project [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note and keeps watching the thread until the task is closed: your [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reply puts the task on an awaiting-reply hold drawn as a hollow [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]paper plane, their reply lifts it and resurfaces the task in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]next review, and `bob gmail sync` runs every 15 minutes on the Mac [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from the chezmoi cron data.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]gmail_sync_reply_watch.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/gmail_sync_reply_watch.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-ii[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-ii/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sync config and the routing-label resolver[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]routing[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]routing: add the gmail.sync config keys with pull fallbacks, a pure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver that turns a thread's prefixed Gmail labels into one area or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]project note or a typed route problem, and doctor rows that audit every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]routing label.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Turn classification and mail-note turn fields[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]turns[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]turns: classify each Gmail message as your move, their move, automated, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bounce, or ignored, fold a thread into whose turn it is, write turn and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]turn_since into mail notes, and upgrade an untouched mail.base with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Waiting for reply view.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The bob gmail sync command, filing, adoption, and the pull [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]alias[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]sync[dim] · [dim][/dim]after routing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sync: build bob gmail sync with paged ids-only discovery, the enrollment[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]journal, the watching-task scan, adoption, label-routed filing through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture's task writer, loud route-problem rows in gmail_inbox.md, human [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and JSON reports, and pull as its permanent hidden alias.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The awaiting-reply hold and the reply lift[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]watch[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sync, turns[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]watch: fetch watched threads every run, refresh their mail notes, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]apply each new turn to every open linking task, holding on your send and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lifting with an \[unblocked:: today] return on their reply, including the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]send finalize hook and the running-session guard.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Route repair, alert-once problems, staleness, and doctor sync[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]health[dim] · [dim][/dim]after watch[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]health: refile a gmail_inbox.md row once its routing label resolves, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]report persisting route problems without failing again, raise a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]staleness alarm when syncs keep skipping, and add a doctor sync row.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The hollow paper-plane awaiting block mark[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mark[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mark: specify and ship the awaiting blocked-reason mark (hollow paper [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plane, waiting family) with its precedence, tooltip, tag fold, Tasks [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]query CSS, conformance vectors, and contrast tests across bob-cli docs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and bob-plugins.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reply badge, no-reply pill, and the daily-note Gmail sync[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]signals[dim] · [dim][/dim]after turns, sync, mark[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]signals: add the display-only reply badge on mail links, the muted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]no-reply pill on nudge-due rows, the Also replied tooltip pip, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]once-per-day Ledger Tools gmail sync when today's daily note is created.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Chezmoi gmail config and the bob-gmail-sync cron job[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]cron[dim] · [dim][/dim]after watch, health[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cron: add Bryan's gmail block (route prefixes # and +, three reply-wait [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]days) to the chezmoi bob config and a Mac bob-gmail-sync job at [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]7,22,37,52 to the cron data, then document the slot in bob-cli.[/#D7D7AF]
